description:
This is the official video introducing the smart energy saving feature of Hylex, Samsung's new cooling & heating system. This video showcases how Hylex helps homeowners stay comfortable while using less energy through advanced inverter technology and smart controls. As energy efficiency becomes increasingly important, homeowners are looking for HVAC systems that can maintain consistent comfort more efficiently than conventional fixed-speed systems.

Q: How much energy can Hylex reduce compared to a traditional system?
A: Compared to a fixed model, Hylex can reduce energy use by up to 13% for cooling and up to 5% for heating when using a general thermostat. When paired with a Samsung wired remote controller, energy use can be reduced by up to 23% for cooling and up to 13% for heating, helping homeowners enjoy smarter and more efficient comfort.

Enjoy efficient comfort with less energy use.
